sv.title: Techprofilernas digitalbank blir påknoppad igen
sv.summary: Den svenskgrundade digitalbanken Majority går ihop med telekombolaget Rebtel. ”Tillsammans blir vi lönsamma och skapar förmåga att investera i nya produkter”, säger vd Magnus Larsson.

en.title: Tech profiles' digital bank gets pumped up again
en.summary: The Swedish-founded digital bank Majority is merging with telecom company Rebtel. “Together we will become profitable and gain the ability to invest in new products,” says CEO Magnus Larsson.
